The composition features two merged profile portraits forming a single harmonious silhouette.
On the left side, the woman is shown in an elegant side profile, facing left. Her hair is styled softly with natural flow (loose waves or gently tucked behind the ear). She wears a modest, refined bridal gown with delicate fabric textures. Her expression carries a gentle, sincere smile with soft, hopeful eyes.
On the right side, the man appears in a side profile facing right, with his gaze slightly lowered. His expression is calm and filled with quiet admiration and love. He is dressed in a well-tailored formal suit.
Both profiles blend seamlessly into each other, creating a romantic and balanced double exposure effect. The edges should merge smoothly without harsh transitions, forming a unified silhouette.
The background is clean, light gray with faint hints of natural scenery subtly visible within the exposure. Lighting is soft yet dramatic, enhancing facial contours, hair texture, and gentle shadows to emphasize depth and emotion.
Style should feel like a timeless studio portrait with a modern artistic touch — highly detailed, clean, and natural, avoiding any artificial or overly processed look.

prompts.title: Eternal Silhouette
prompts.prompt:
Use the provided reference images to match the identity, age, and facial features of both subjects. Preserve their natural facial structure, proportions, hairline, and overall likeness. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter their identities in any way. Ensure the silhouettes still reflect the correct face shape and recognizable profile of each subject.
Create a dramatic black-and-white high-contrast silhouette portrait of a couple standing extremely close to each other in an almost-kiss pose.
Composition & Framing
Vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.
Close-up framing from the chest or shoulders upward. The couple is centered in the frame, facing each other in profile.
Man (left side): Facing right. He has short, neatly styled hair and light stubble, wearing a formal blazer with a collared shirt. His head is slightly tilted downward toward the woman.
Woman (right side): Facing left. She has naturally long, wavy hair with a floral hairpiece positioned on the upper side of her head, small earrings, and an elegant outfit with subtle decorative details. Her head is slightly tilted upward toward the man.
Their noses are almost touching and their foreheads nearly meet. They maintain direct eye contact with each other, creating a romantic and intimate moment.
Lighting & Style
The couple appears as deep black silhouettes against a pure bright white backlit background. Strong rim lighting clearly defines the contours of their faces, hair, and bodies, creating a sharp separation between the subjects and the background.
The image should resemble professional cinematic studio silhouette photography with crisp edges, smooth gradients, and strong contrast. Render the image in high-contrast monochrome with high-key lighting and absolutely no color.
Typography
Place the text centered at the top of the image with clear spacing from the edge.
Title: “ENDLESS LOVE” in a large, elegant serif font.
Subtitle below the title:
“Loved you yesterday, love you still, always have, always will.”
Use a thin, spaced grey font for the subtitle.

prompts.title: Velvet & Maroon
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed 8K vertical portrait (4:5 aspect ratio) of an elegant couple in a classic studio setting. Use the provided reference image to replicate the subjects’ exact identity and facial structure with high accuracy — preserve bone anatomy, proportions, natural asymmetry, and realistic skin texture.
Full-length framing with the entire gown and shoes visible. Symmetrical composition, eye-level camera angle, centered subjects. Shallow depth of field. Captured on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.8 for natural compression and refined background blur.
Mood & Style
Timeless romance with a luxury wedding editorial aesthetic. Deep burgundy and crimson color palette accented by black, white, and gold details. Warm cinematic color grading with rich contrast and elegant tonal depth.
Woman (Left)
Natural smooth complexion with soft-glam makeup: subtle rosy blush, pink lipstick, defined brows, soft eyeliner. Middle-parted hair styled in glossy, voluminous waves falling over both shoulders.
Wearing a deep crimson off-shoulder satin gown with a crossover sweetheart neckline, fitted bodice, long sleeves, and a dramatic pleated floor-length skirt. Small delicate dangling earrings.
She holds a large bouquet in her right arm near his waist — composed of white lilies, pink roses, yellow and white daisies, subtle purple accents, lush green foliage, tied with a soft cream ribbon.
Man (Right)
Natural complexion with neatly styled hair and beard (if present in the reference image). Calm, subtle closed-mouth smile with direct eye contact.
Wearing a sophisticated, slim-fit blazer in a rich burgundy velvet fabric, a white shirt with top buttons open (no tie), slim black trousers, and polished black leather dress shoes.
Pose & Interaction
The couple stands close together, slightly angled inward toward each other. His left hand gently holds her left hand near his waist. She holds the bouquet naturally in her right arm near his waist. Both maintain relaxed posture, calm expressions, and direct eye contact.
Background
Dark muted burgundy wall with refined wooden paneling. Behind them, an ornate gold frame featuring a dark floral oil painting. Background softly blurred yet clearly recognizable.
Lighting & Detail
Soft diffused studio key light from front-left. Gentle shadow falloff in a Rembrandt/loop lighting style. Subtle rim light for separation from background. HDR rendering, sharp natural skin texture, detailed fabric folds, realistic satin reflections, photorealistic finish.

prompts.title: Indian Couple 90s Bollywood
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly as the ONLY face and identity reference.
Create a cinematic 8K portrait of a couple standing side-by-side against a textured rustic terracotta wall, illuminated by warm golden hour sunlight that casts soft shadows and enhances skin tones.
Composition & Framing:
Medium full shot (knee to slightly above head), vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Subjects centered with balanced negative space. Clean background with subtle wall texture, no distractions.
Pose & Interaction:
The couple stands close together, gently holding hands. Both bodies slightly angled toward each other. They share a soft, affectionate gaze, creating an intimate and nostalgic mood.
Expression:
Natural, calm, and warm expressions with slight smiles. Eyes focused on each other, conveying romantic connection.
Outfit Details:
Woman: Navy-blue velvet blouse with intricate gold embroidery, paired with a black lehenga featuring rich gold floral patterns. A visible layered white underskirt adds depth. She wears a flowing red dupatta with gold border detailing draped elegantly. Accessories include large traditional gold earrings and a red rose tucked into her hair.
Man: Black embroidered Chikan kurta with detailed white threadwork on the neckline, paired with tailored black trousers.
Hair & Styling:
Natural, well-groomed hair. Soft, realistic texture with subtle movement. No artificial shine.
Lighting:
Warm golden hour sunlight from the side, creating soft highlights on faces and gentle shadows on the wall. Natural light falloff for cinematic depth.
Background:
Minimal rustic terracotta wall with slight imperfections and texture. No people or distractions in the background.
Style & Mood:
Cinematic, nostalgic 90s Bollywood print-photo aesthetic. Slight film grain, soft contrast, warm color grading, and subtle vignette for vintage realism.
Technical Details:
Ultra-realistic, 8K resolution, shallow depth of field (light background softness), sharp focus on subjects, natural skin texture (visible pores), no plastic or CGI look.
